existing_dashboard_modification: The mobile block overrode display and overflow but not height, so a phone kept a body exactly 100vh tall -- and on iOS 100vh is the viewport with the chrome hidden, which is taller than what you can see whenever the toolbar is showing. The body now grows, with min-height:100svh for the full-screen feel; .paper and .tablewrap use dvh. Every declaration is written vh-then-modern, so a browser without dvh keeps today's behaviour exactly.
generation_source: read from UTC clock at build time, never chosen
rollback: build again with --from an earlier release; nothing is edited in place
